items.mainDefect: Truthiness-based mutual-exclusion checks treat zero-valued age or timestamp fields as absent.

secondary.defect: Reports containing neither age nor timestamp pass validation because neither field is required and no object-level presence check exists.

items.mainDefect: Truthiness-based mutual-exclusion checks fail to enforce exclusion for zero-valued age or timestamp fields.

secondary.defect: The age field lacks a minimum-value constraint.
The new mutual-exclusion test covers only nonzero values, leaving zero-valued cases untested.
